name: Irma and Milli - The UNDER COVERs
original_name: イルマ＆ミリィ　The UNDER COVERs
source:
Irma Asta and Milliam Duffoner are the most famous partners in the notorious 2nd division.
All the things they do are over-the-top.
They are currently working on the serial case involving missing women.
However, they couldn't embark on the investigation of the suspected organization named Onzereau, which is one of the biggest criminal organizations in Europe.
They decided to penetrate their stronghold called "Guest Palace" to clean their tarnished reputation and solve the case.
However, what they found in the establishment was scenes of a very filthy sex-related business...

Can they resolve the case?
And also, can they make their way out of the Guest Palace safely!?

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE063289.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
伊尔玛·阿斯塔与米莉亚姆·迪夫纳，是臭名昭著的第二分署最有名的搭档。
她们做起任何事来都格外夸张。
目前，二人正在调查一系列女性失踪案。
然而，她们始终无法正式调查涉嫌此案的昂斯洛商会——欧洲规模最大的犯罪组织之一。
为了挽回受损的名声并侦破案件，她们决定潜入该组织名为“迎宾馆”的据点。
可二人在设施内看到的，却是一幕幕肮脏不堪的色情交易……

她们能否侦破案件？
又能否平安逃出迎宾馆？！
